subject.title: feat(config): use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw switch config backup retention from the current numbered ring to timestamped backup filenames, and if so should legacy numbered backups be preserved, converted, or pruned on upgrade?
rationale: The user benefit is clear, but backup naming and legacy retention affect config recovery behavior for existing installs and need maintainer intent before merging a compatibility-sensitive config change.

options.title: Land migration-safe timestamped backups
options.body: Adopt datetime suffixes while preserving or converting existing `.bak.1` through `.bak.4` recovery points and proving upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Keep numbered ring for now
options.body: Leave the current backup contract unchanged and defer or close the linked implementation until maintainers want to change recovery file naming.

recommendation.title: Land migration-safe timestamped backups
recommendation.body: Adopt datetime suffixes while preserving or converting existing `.bak.1` through `.bak.4` recovery points and proving upgrade behavior before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible config backup and config I/O history among the likely owners.
